+def test_named_text_wrapper_does_not_close_shared_buffer():
+    buffer = BytesIO()
+    first = _NamedTextIOWrapper(
+        buffer, encoding="utf-8", name="<first>", mode="w"
+    )
+    second = _NamedTextIOWrapper(
+        buffer, encoding="utf-8", name="<second>", mode="w"
+    )
+
+    first.write("first")
+    first.flush()
+    del first
+    gc.collect()
+
+    second.write(" second")
+    second.flush()
+    assert buffer.getvalue() == b"first second"
+
+
+def test_runner_keeps_logging_stream_usable_between_invocations():
+    streams = []
+
+    @click.command()
+    def cli():
+        streams.append(sys.stderr)
+        click.echo("invoked")
+
+    runner = CliRunner()
+    first = runner.invoke(cli)
+    gc.collect()
+
+    assert not streams[0].closed
+    handler = logging.StreamHandler(streams[0])
+    handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(message)s"))
+    record = logging.LogRecord("test", logging.INFO, "", 0, "logged", (), None)
+    handler.emit(record)
+    handler.flush()
+
+    second = runner.invoke(cli)
+    assert first.output == "invoked\n"
+    assert second.output == "invoked\n"
+
